interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.30.0: opt-in evaluator identity and improvement-cost evidence. Native runs can bind selected evaluator code and JSON configuration snapshots; changed or incompatible bindings are refused. A separate cost tool records source-bound, caller-reported generation, evaluation, selection and recording resources, including failed and discarded attempts. Unknown values remain null with known subtotals shown separately. Cost comparisons retain native performance eligibility and do not establish efficiency or authorize application. Hashes, recorder labels and scope-completeness declarations do not authenticate execution or metering. Without evaluator options legacy run manifests and IDs remain unchanged. Existing 15 slash commands, default hooks/search, Python 3.10+ standard-library runtime, Jarvis API authentication and v0.26.0 upgrade requirements remain. No model/network/command execution, new runtime dependency or automatic vault migration is added.
defaultPrompt: Use agentic-vault to restore this vault's session context.
Use agentic-vault to find the sources for our last deployment decision.
